SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.expandInterv.text:
theorem expandInterval_contractedLeaf (t : IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) :
    t.expandInterval t.contractedLeaf = t.spanInterval

theorem expandInterval_contains (t : IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
    (J : BoundaryInterval t.contractedSize) :
    ((t.expandInterval J).left ≤ t.lower ∧ t.upper ≤ (t.expandInterval J).right) ↔
      (J.left ≤ t.contractedLeaf.left ∧ t.contractedLeaf.right ≤ J.right)

theorem expandInterval_injective (t : IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) :
    Function.Injective t.expandInterval

SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.expand_contr.text:
theorem expand_contractInterval (t : IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (I : BoundaryInterval n)
    (hl : I.left ≤ t.lower ∨ t.upper ≤ I.left)
    (hr : I.right ≤ t.lower ∨ t.upper ≤ I.right) :
    t.expandInterval (t.contractInterval I hl hr) = I

SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.contract_exp.text:
theorem contract_expandInterval (t : IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
    (J : BoundaryInterval t.contractedSize) :
    t.contractInterval (t.expandInterval J) (t.expandPosition_survives J.left)
      (t.expandPosition_survives J.right) = J

SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.containing_i.text:
theorem containing_interval_is_expanded (t : IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
    (I : BoundaryInterval n) (hI : I.left ≤ t.lower ∧ t.upper ≤ I.right) :
    ∃ J : BoundaryInterval t.contractedSize,
      t.expandInterval J = I ∧ J.left ≤ t.contractedLeaf.left ∧ t.contractedLeaf.right ≤ J.right

SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.expandInterv.text:
theorem expandInterval_full (t : IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (hproper : t.spanInterval ≠ fullBoundaryInterval hn) :
    t.expandInterval (fullBoundaryInterval (t.contractedSize_of_proper hn hproper)) =
      fullBoundaryInterval hn

SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.containing_c.text:
theorem containing_contracted_nonleaf (t : IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
    (J : BoundaryInterval t.contractedSize)
    (hJ : J.left ≤ t.contractedLeaf.left ∧ t.contractedLeaf.right ≤ J.right)
    (hne : J ≠ t.contractedLeaf) : 2 ≤ J.leaves

source_assessments: Expansion applies the same strict surviving-position map to every interval endpoint and all three triple entries; it preserves physical positions and order.
Contraction is defined on exactly the intervals whose two endpoints survive. Both round trips are exact interval equalities, not just equal lengths.
The distinguished leaf is adjacent contracted positions lower and lower+1, expands to the complete critical span, and has one leaf.

Strict-monotone order reflection makes containing the old span equivalent to containing the new leaf. Every containing old interval has surviving endpoints and is represented; the consumer adds uniqueness.
The full expanded interval uses size>=3 only in the proper source polygon case. Full-span two-position behavior remains available through contractInterval and contractedLeaf.

A containing contracted interval distinct from the leaf must have at least two leaves: otherwise its bounded integer endpoints would be precisely the two leaf endpoints. The consumers specialize this to the actual inverse equation and its one-leaf base.
